concepts.title: 指数函数特征
concepts.summary: 对 $y=c^x$，$c>0$ 且 $c\ne1$；定义域为实数，值域为正数，纵截距为 $(0,1)$。

method.title: 读底数与图像
method.body: 当 $c>1$ 时递增；当 $0<c<1$ 时递减。用已知点代入求底数，水平渐近线为 $y=0$。

pitfalls: 指数函数趋近渐近线，不会到达渐近线。

en.title: Characteristics of exponential functions
en.summary: For $y=c^x$, $c>0$ and $c\ne1$. The domain is all real numbers, the range is positive, and the y-intercept is $(0,1)$.

method.title: Read the base and graph
method.body: The function increases for $c>1$ and decreases for $0<c<1$. Substitute a given point to determine the base; the horizontal asymptote is $y=0$.

pitfalls: An exponential curve approaches its horizontal asymptote without reaching it.

concepts.title: 指数图像变换
concepts.summary:
对非恒定函数 $y=a c^{b(x-h)}+k$（$c>0,c
e1,a
e0,b
e0$），水平伸缩因子为 $1/|b|$，竖直伸缩因子为 $|a|$，平移为 $(h,k)$。

method.title: 变换关键点
method.body: 将 $y=c^x$ 上的 $(u,v)$ 变为 $(u/b+h,av+k)$；$a<0$ 关于横轴反射，$b<0$ 关于纵轴反射。先伸缩、反射，再平移。

pitfalls: 先把指数写成 $b(x-h)$；水平渐近线为 $y=k$，不能把水平位移 $h$ 当作渐近线高度。

en.title: Transformations of exponential graphs
en.summary:
For the nonconstant function $y=a c^{b(x-h)}+k$ ($c>0,c
e1,a
e0,b
e0$), the horizontal scale factor is $1/|b|$, the vertical scale factor is $|a|$, and the translation is $(h,k)$.

method.title: Transform key points
method.body: Map a point $(u,v)$ on $y=c^x$ to $(u/b+h,av+k)$. Negative $a$ reflects in the x-axis; negative $b$ reflects in the y-axis. Scale and reflect before translating.

pitfalls: Factor the exponent as $b(x-h)$ first. The horizontal asymptote is $y=k$; do not confuse the horizontal shift $h$ with the asymptote height.

concepts.title: 解指数方程
concepts.summary: 能化为相同合法底数时令指数相等；底数不同时可用图像交点和数值逼近。

method.title: 写出可核对的方程
method.body: 先用幂的乘方与负指数法则化简，再解一次方程；图解结果注明近似及舍入位数。

pitfalls: 不要把不同底数的指数直接设为相等。

en.title: Solving exponential equations
en.summary: Equate exponents after rewriting with a common valid base; otherwise use graph intersections and numerical approximation.

method.title: Form a checkable equation
method.body: Use powers of powers and negative exponent laws, then solve the resulting linear equation. Label graphical results as approximate and round as requested.

pitfalls: Exponents of unequal bases cannot simply be equated.

concepts.title: 增长、衰减与实际时间
concepts.summary: 增长因子为 $1+r$；半衰期为 $h$ 的剩余量为 $M_0(1/2)^{t/h}$。每年复利 $m$ 次用 $A=P(1+r/m)^{mt}$。

method.title: 设定时间起点和单位
method.body: 明确初值、每期因子与期数，代入目标值；用图像或逐步逼近求时间，再应用整数期数等实际限制。

pitfalls: 百分比损失与剩余百分比不同；按期入账时须向上取整到完整期数。

en.title: Growth, decay, and contextual time
en.summary: A growth factor is $1+r$; a quantity with half-life $h$ is $M_0(1/2)^{t/h}$. Interest compounded $m$ times per year gives $A=P(1+r/m)^{mt}$.

method.title: Set the time origin and units
method.body: Identify the initial amount, factor per period, and number of periods. Substitute the target, estimate time by graphing or iteration, and apply constraints such as whole credited periods.

pitfalls: Distinguish a percentage blocked from the percentage transmitted. For periodically credited interest, round up to a whole period.

exercises.prompt: 选择最佳答案。考虑 $y=2^x$、$y=(2/3)^x$ 和 $y=7^x$，哪个 $x$ 值使三者有相同的 $y$ 值？A) $-1$；B) $0$；C) $1$；D) 不存在这样的 $x$ 值。

en.prompt: Choose the best answer. For $y=2^x$, $y=(2/3)^x$, and $y=7^x$, which x-value results in the same y-value for each? A) $-1$; B) $0$; C) $1$; D) There is no such value of x.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Every positive base raised to zero equals 1: $2^0=(2/3)^0=7^0=1$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: At $x=-1$ the values are $1/2,3/2,1/7$, and at $x=1$ they are $2,2/3,7$, so these do not agree. Choose B.

exercises.prompt: 选择最佳答案。怎样把 $y=3^x$ 变为 $y=3^{(x-5)/4}-2$？A) 纵向伸缩因子为 $1/4$，向左平移 5、向上平移 2；B) 横向伸缩因子为 $1/4$，向右平移 2、向下平移 5；C) 横向伸长 4 倍，向右平移 5、向下平移 2；D) 横向伸长 4 倍，向左平移 2、向上平移 5。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: $x-5$ 表示向右 5，外面的 $-2$ 表示向下 2；外系数为 1，无纵向伸缩。因此选择 C。

en.prompt: Choose the best answer. Which statement describes transforming $y=3^x$ into $y=3^{(x-5)/4}-2$? A) Stretch vertically by a factor of $1/4$ and translate 5 units left and 2 units up. B) Stretch horizontally by a factor of $1/4$ and translate 2 units right and 5 units down. C) Stretch horizontally by a factor of 4 and translate 5 units right and 2 units down. D) Stretch horizontally by a factor of 4 and translate 2 units left and 5 units up.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: The exponent is $(1/4)(x-5)$, so $b=1/4$ and the horizontal scale factor is $1/|b|=4$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: The term $x-5$ gives right 5, and the outside $-2$ gives down 2. The outside coefficient is 1, so there is no vertical stretch. Choose C.

exercises.prompt: 选择最佳答案。一辆古董汽车的价值每 10 年翻倍，现值为 100 000 元。20 年前的价值是多少？A) 50 000 元；B) 25 000 元；C) 12 500 元；D) 5000 元。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 20 年包含 $20/10=2$ 个翻倍周期。从现值倒推，每个周期除以 2。

en.prompt: Choose the best answer. An antique automobile doubles in value every 10 years. Its current value is 100 000 dollars. What was its value 20 years ago? A) 50 000 dollars; B) 25 000 dollars; C) 12 500 dollars; D) 5000 dollars.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Twenty years contains $20/10=2$ doubling periods. Working backwards divides the value by 2 for each period.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: The past value is $100000/2^2=100000/4=25000$ dollars, so choose B. Check: $25000\cdot2\cdot2=100000$.

en.prompt: Choose the best answer. What is $\dfrac{2^9}{(4^3)^2}$ expressed as a power of 2? A) $2^{-3}$; B) $2^3$; C) $2^1$; D) $2^{-1}$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: First rewrite the denominator: $(4^3)^2=4^6=(2^2)^6=2^{12}$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Apply the quotient law: $2^9/2^{12}=2^{9-12}=2^{-3}$. Choose A.

exercises.prompt: 选择最佳答案。穿过太阳镜玻璃的光强 $I$（流明）由 $I(x)=I_0(0.8)^x$ 给出，$x$ 为玻璃厚度（毫米），$I_0$ 为进入玻璃前的光强。若要阻挡进入太阳镜的光的 $25\%$，玻璃厚度大约应为多少？A) $0.7$ mm；B) $0.8$ mm；C) $1.1$ mm；D) $1.3$ mm。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: 用图像或逼近求得 $x\approx1.289224$ mm。检查 $0.8^{1.3}\approx0.7482$，约透过 $74.82\%$，即阻挡约 $25.18\%$；四选项中最合适的是 D。

en.prompt: Choose the best answer. The intensity I, in lumens, of light passing through sunglasses glass is $I(x)=I_0(0.8)^x$, where x is the glass thickness in millimetres and $I_0$ is the intensity entering the glasses. Approximately how thick should the glass be to block $25\%$ of the entering light? A) $0.7$ mm; B) $0.8$ mm; C) $1.1$ mm; D) $1.3$ mm.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Blocking $25\%$ means transmitting $75\%$, so $I=0.75I_0$ with $I_0>0$. Substitute and divide by $I_0$ to get $0.8^x=0.75$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Graphing or numerical refinement gives $x\approx1.289224$ mm. Check $0.8^{1.3}\approx0.7482$: about $74.82\%$ passes and $25.18\%$ is blocked. The best choice is D.

exercises.prompt: 分别求原图 a)、b) 中变换后红色图像的函数方程。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: b) 红色渐近线为 $y=-4$，曲线在其下方。与 $y=2^x$ 比较，先右移 2、关于横轴反射、再下移 4，得 $y=-2^{x-2}-4$。

en.prompt: Determine the function represented by each transformed red graph, a) and b), in the given figure.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) The base function is $y=5^x$ and the red asymptote is $y=2$. Subtract 2 from the labelled y-values: at $x=-3,-2,-1$ the values become $1,5,25$, which are $5^0,5^1,5^2$. Thus the exponent is $x+3$, giving $y=5^{x+3}+2$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: a) This is left 3 and up 2. Substituting the three marked x-values gives $5^0+2=3$, $5^1+2=7$, and $5^2+2=27$, matching every label.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: b) The red asymptote is $y=-4$ and the curve lies below it. Starting from $y=2^x$, translate right 2, reflect in the x-axis, and translate down 4: $y=-2^{x-2}-4$.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: b) Substituting $x=1,2,3$ gives $-1/2-4=-9/2$, $-1-4=-5$, and $-2-4=-6$, matching all three marked points.

exercises.answer: a) 递增，渐近线 $y=2$；b) 递减，渐近线 $y=-2$；c) 递增，渐近线 $y=-4$；标注点与图像见步骤及解析图。

en.prompt: Sketch and label the graph of each exponential function. a) $y=\tfrac12(3)^x+2$; b) $y=-2(\tfrac32)^{x-1}-2$; c) $y=3^{2(x+3)}-4$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) Vertically scale $3^x$ by $1/2$ and translate up 2. At $x=0,1,2$ the points are $(0,5/2),(1,7/2),(2,13/2)$. Sketch an increasing curve through them, with asymptote $y=2$, range $y>2$, and no x-intercept.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: b) Translate $(3/2)^x$ right 1, stretch vertically by 2 and reflect in the x-axis, then translate down 2. Key points are $(0,-10/3),(1,-4),(2,-5),(3,-13/2)$. The curve decreases, with asymptote $y=-2$, range $y<-2$, and no x-intercept.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: c) Horizontally scale $3^x$ by $1/2$, translate left 3 and down 4. Key points are $(-7/2,-11/3),(-3,-3),(-5/2,-1),(-2,5)$. The curve increases with asymptote $y=-4$ and range $y>-4$. Its y-intercept is $(0,725)$, outside the displayed window; its x-intercept is about $(-2.3691,0)$. All three domains are $\mathbb R$.

en.answer: a) Increasing, asymptote $y=2$; b) decreasing, asymptote $y=-2$; c) increasing, asymptote $y=-4$. See the labelled points and solution graphs.

exercises.prompt: 考虑函数 $g(x)=2(3)^{x+3}-4$。a) 求基本函数并说明变为 $g(x)$ 所需的变换。b) 画出 $g(x)$。c) 写出 $g(x)$ 的定义域、值域和水平渐近线方程。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) 基本函数是 $f(x)=3^x$。外系数 2 表示纵向伸长 2 倍；$x+3=x-(-3)$ 表示左移 3；外面的 $-4$ 表示下移 4。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: c) 指数对所有实数有定义，且 $2(3)^{x+3}>0$，所以定义域为 $\mathbb R$，值域为 $(-4,\infty)$；向左趋近的水平渐近线为 $y=-4$。

exercises.answer: a) 基本函数 $3^x$；纵向 2 倍、左移 3、下移 4；b) 见图；c) $D=\mathbb R$，$R=(-4,\infty)$，渐近线 $y=-4$。

en.prompt: Consider $g(x)=2(3)^{x+3}-4$. a) Determine the base function and describe the transformations needed to obtain g. b) Graph g. c) Identify the domain, range, and horizontal asymptote.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) The base function is $f(x)=3^x$. The outside coefficient 2 stretches vertically by a factor of 2; $x+3=x-(-3)$ translates left 3; the outside $-4$ translates down 4.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: b) Apply $(u,v)\mapsto(u-3,2v-4)$. Base points $(-1,1/3),(0,1),(1,3),(2,9)$ become $(-4,-10/3),(-3,-2),(-2,2),(-1,14)$. Also $g(0)=54-4=50$. Draw an increasing curve through these points.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: c) The exponential is defined for every real x, and $2(3)^{x+3}>0$. Thus the domain is $\mathbb R$, the range is $(-4,\infty)$, and the horizontal asymptote approached on the left is $y=-4$.

en.answer: a) Base $3^x$; vertical factor 2, left 3, down 4; b) see graph; c) $D=\mathbb R$, $R=(-4,\infty)$, asymptote $y=-4$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) Since $9=3^2$, the right side becomes $3^{2(x-4)/2}=3^{x-4}$. Equate exponents: $2x=x-4$, so $x=-4$. Both sides then equal $3^{-8}$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: b) Since $27=3^3$ and $9=3^2$, $3^{3x-12}=3^{2x+6}$. Solving $3x-12=2x+6$ gives $x=18$. Both original sides become $3^{42}$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: c) Since $1024=2^{10}$ and $16=2^4$, $2^{20x-10}=2^{4x+16}$. Thus $16x=26$ and $x=13/8$. Both exponents become $45/2$. Every common base is valid, so each equation has exactly the one real solution found.

exercises.prompt: 使用绘图技术解各方程，答案保留一位小数。a) $3=1.12^x$；b) $2.7=0.3^{2x-1}$。

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) 绘制 $y_1=1.12^x$ 和水平线 $y_2=3$。递增曲线与直线的唯一交点约为 $(9.694035,3)$，因此 $x\approx9.7$。

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: a) 舍入前的根位于 $9.69$ 与 $9.70$ 之间；代回舍入值时 $1.12^{9.7}\approx3.0020$，符合图解近似。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: b) 绘制 $y_1=0.3^{2x-1}$ 和 $y_2=2.7$。第一条曲线严格递减，唯一交点约为 $(0.087511,2.7)$，因此保留一位小数为 $x\approx0.1$。

en.prompt: Solve each equation using graphing technology. Round answers to one decimal place. a) $3=1.12^x$; b) $2.7=0.3^{2x-1}$.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) Plot $y_1=1.12^x$ and the horizontal line $y_2=3$. The increasing curve meets the line once, at about $(9.694035,3)$, giving $x\approx9.7$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: a) The unrounded root is between $9.69$ and $9.70$. At the rounded value, $1.12^{9.7}\approx3.0020$, consistent with a graphical approximation.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: b) Plot $y_1=0.3^{2x-1}$ and $y_2=2.7$. The first curve strictly decreases and meets the line once, at about $(0.087511,2.7)$. To one decimal place, $x\approx0.1$.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: b) The unrounded root is between $0.0875$ and $0.0876$. Substitution gives $0.3^{2(0.087511)-1}\approx2.7000$. The requested one-decimal value $0.1$ is a coarse approximation, not an exact root.

exercises.prompt: 据 2010 年发布的加拿大统计局报告，萨斯卡通当时是加拿大人口增长最快的城市，年增长率为 $2.77\%$。a) 若增长率不变，一年后人口乘以什么因子？b) 可用哪个函数描述此情境？c) 该情境中函数的定义域和值域是什么？d) 按此增长率，人口增长 $25\%$ 大约需多久？

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: b) 设 $P_0>0$ 为选定起始时刻的人口，$t$ 为此后年数（例如以 2010 年为 $t=0$）。保持题给增长率不变的模型为 $P(t)=P_0(1.0277)^t$；没有给出 $P_0$ 数值，不能捏造实际人口。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: c) 向未来预测的连续模型取 $t\in[0,\infty)$，其值域为 $P\in[P_0,\infty)$。人口实际是整数，此指数函数是近似模型；若只逐年记录，则定义域为 $n=0,1,2,\ldots$，值域为离散数列 $P_0(1.0277)^n$。

steps.title: 第 4 步
steps.body: d) 增长 $25\%$ 时 $P=1.25P_0$，所以 $(1.0277)^t=1.25$。图解或数值逼近得 $t\approx8.166788$ 年，即约 $8.2$ 年；若仅在每个整年观察，第一次超过目标是第 9 年。

en.prompt: According to a Statistics Canada report released in 2010, Saskatoon had the fastest-growing population in Canada, with an annual growth rate of $2.77\%$. a) If the rate remained constant, by what factor would the population be multiplied after 1 year? b) What function could model the situation? c) State its domain and range for this situation. d) At this rate, approximately how long would population take to grow by $25\%$?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) The growth factor is $1+0.0277=1.0277$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: b) Let $P_0>0$ be the population at the chosen starting date and t the years afterwards (for example, take $t=0$ in 2010). A constant-rate model is $P(t)=P_0(1.0277)^t$. The problem supplies no numerical initial population, so none can be inferred.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: c) For a continuous model predicting forward, use $t\in[0,\infty)$ and $P\in[P_0,\infty)$. Actual population is a whole number; this exponential is an approximation. If observations are only annual, use $n=0,1,2,\ldots$ and the discrete range $P_0(1.0277)^n$.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: d) A $25\%$ increase means $P=1.25P_0$, so $(1.0277)^t=1.25$. Graphing or numerical refinement gives $t\approx8.166788$ years, or about $8.2$ years. If only whole-year observations are allowed, year 9 is the first above the target.

en.answer: a) $1.0277$; b) $P=P_0(1.0277)^t$; c) continuous model: $t\ge0$, $P\ge P_0$; d) about $8.2$ years.

exercises.prompt: 溶液酸度的度量称为 pH。游泳池需要定期测量水中氢离子（$\mathrm H^+$）浓度，以检查 pH。氢离子浓度 $H$（mol/L）与 pH 值 $P$ 的关系为 $H(P)=(1/10)^P$；原图给出 pH 刻度。a) 画出此函数图像。b) pH 小于 $7.0$ 的水呈酸性；pH 为 $7.0$ 时氢离子浓度是多少？c) 泳池 pH 应在 $7.0$ 与 $7.6$ 之间；对应氢离子浓度的范围是多少？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: a) 取 $P=0,1,2,3$，得到 $H=1,0.1,0.01,0.001$ mol/L。底数 $0.1$ 介于 0 与 1 之间，因此曲线严格递减，水平渐近线为 $H=0$，不与横轴相交。解析图显示题给 pH 刻度 $0\le P\le14$ 内的曲线；作为纯数学指数函数，其定义域可为全部实数，值域为正数。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: c) 随 pH 增大浓度减小，所以最大浓度在 $P=7.0$：$10^{-7}$ mol/L；最小浓度在 $P=7.6$：$10^{-7.6}\approx2.511886\times10^{-8}$ mol/L。

steps.title: 第 4 步
steps.body: c) 因此按含端点的 pH 区间 $[7.0,7.6]$，浓度区间为 $[10^{-7.6},10^{-7}]$ mol/L。若将“之间”理解为严格区间，浓度端点也相应不含；单调递减导致不等号方向反转。

exercises.answer: a) 递减指数图，见解析图；b) $10^{-7}$ mol/L；c) $10^{-7.6}\le H\le10^{-7}$ mol/L，即约 $2.51\times10^{-8}\le H\le1.00\times10^{-7}$ mol/L。

en.prompt: The acidity of a solution is measured by its pH. Swimming-pool pH must be checked regularly by measuring hydrogen ion ($\mathrm H^+$) concentration. The relationship between concentration H, in moles per litre (mol/L), and pH P is $H(P)=(1/10)^P$. The given diagram shows the pH scale. a) Sketch the graph. b) Water with pH less than $7.0$ is acidic. What is the hydrogen ion concentration at pH $7.0$? c) Swimming-pool water should have pH between $7.0$ and $7.6$. What is the equivalent range of hydrogen ion concentration?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: a) At $P=0,1,2,3$, $H=1,0.1,0.01,0.001$ mol/L. Since the base $0.1$ lies between 0 and 1, the curve strictly decreases, has horizontal asymptote $H=0$, and never meets the horizontal axis. The graph shows the given pH scale $0\le P\le14$; as a purely mathematical exponential, its domain can be all real numbers and its range is positive.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: b) $H(7)=(1/10)^7=10^{-7}$ mol/L. A pH of 7.0 is neutral, outside the stated acidic region below 7.0.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: c) Concentration decreases as pH increases. The maximum occurs at $P=7.0$: $10^{-7}$ mol/L. The minimum occurs at $P=7.6$: $10^{-7.6}\approx2.511886\times10^{-8}$ mol/L.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: c) Taking the pH interval as inclusive, $[7.0,7.6]$ corresponds to $[10^{-7.6},10^{-7}]$ mol/L. If “between” is interpreted strictly, both concentration endpoints are excluded too. The decreasing function reverses the endpoint order.

en.answer: a) Decreasing exponential; see graph. b) $10^{-7}$ mol/L. c) $10^{-7.6}\le H\le10^{-7}$ mol/L, approximately $2.51\times10^{-8}\le H\le1.00\times10^{-7}$ mol/L.

exercises.prompt: Lucas 希望大学毕业后度假，估计需要 5000 元。他在大学最后一年结束时有 3500 元投资，年利率为 $8.4\%$，按季度复利。他需等待多久，才有足够的钱度假？

steps.title: 第 1 步
steps.body: 每年有 4 个季度，每季度利率为 $0.084/4=0.021$，增长因子为 $1.021$。设 $n$ 为从毕业起已计息的完整季度数，则 $A_n=3500(1.021)^n$。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: 实际按季度入账，要有 $A_n\ge5000$ 的最小整数 $n$。检查 $A_{17}\approx4983.17$ 元仍不够；$A_{18}\approx5087.82$ 元足够。

steps.title: 第 4 步
steps.body: 因此首个可用余额达到目标的季度是第 18 季，等待 $18/4=4.5$ 年，即 4 年 6 个月。若只按连续时间插值模型报告，则临界时间约 4.29 年；季度到账限制使实际可取用的时间成为 4.5 年。

exercises.answer: 按季度入账，需等待 18 个季度，即 $4.5$ 年（4 年 6 个月）。连续时间插值的临界值约为 $4.29$ 年。

en.prompt: Lucas hopes to take a vacation after finishing university and estimates that he needs 5000 dollars. He finishes his last university year with 3500 dollars invested at $8.4\%$ per year, compounded quarterly. How long must he wait to have enough money for the vacation?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: There are 4 quarters per year, so the quarterly rate is $0.084/4=0.021$ and the factor is $1.021$. Let n count complete credited quarters since graduation. Then $A_n=3500(1.021)^n$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: First locate the threshold: $3500(1.021)^n=5000$, or $1.021^n=10/7$. Graphing or numerical refinement gives $n\approx17.16224$, corresponding to the continuous-time interpolation $t=n/4\approx4.29056$ years.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: For quarterly credited interest, use the smallest integer n with $A_n\ge5000$. Check $A_{17}\approx4983.17$ dollars, which is insufficient, and $A_{18}\approx5087.82$ dollars, which is enough.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: The first qualifying credited balance is at quarter 18: $18/4=4.5$ years, or 4 years 6 months. A continuous interpolation gives the threshold about 4.29 years; quarterly crediting makes the first available qualifying balance occur at 4.5 years.

en.answer: With quarterly credited interest, wait 18 quarters: $4.5$ years (4 years 6 months). The continuous interpolated threshold is about $4.29$ years.

exercises.prompt: 一台原价 3000 元的电脑按 $V(t)=3000(1/2)^{t/3}$ 贬值，其中 $V$ 为 $t$ 年后的价值（元）。价值降至购买价的 $10\%$ 大约需多久？

steps.title: 第 2 步
steps.body: 每 3 年价值减半。3 次减半后（9 年）剩 $1/8=12.5\%$；4 次后（12 年）剩 $1/16=6.25\%$，因此所求时间位于 9 与 12 年之间。

steps.title: 第 3 步
steps.body: 绘制 $y=(1/2)^{t/3}$ 与 $y=0.1$ 并逼近，得 $t\approx9.965784$ 年；代回约得 300 元。因为模型连续且严格递减，只有这个非负时间。

en.prompt: A computer originally purchased for 3000 dollars depreciates according to $V(t)=3000(1/2)^{t/3}$, where V is its value in dollars at time t in years. Approximately how long will it take to be worth $10\%$ of its purchase price?

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Ten percent of the purchase price is $0.10\cdot3000=300$ dollars. Set $3000(1/2)^{t/3}=300$ and divide by 3000 to get $(1/2)^{t/3}=0.1$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: The value halves every 3 years. After three halvings (9 years) the fraction is $1/8=12.5\%$; after four (12 years) it is $1/16=6.25\%$. The required time lies between 9 and 12 years.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Graph $y=(1/2)^{t/3}$ and $y=0.1$ and refine their intersection to obtain $t\approx9.965784$ years. Substitution gives about 300 dollars. The continuous model strictly decreases, so this is its only nonnegative solution.
